contact.form.privacy: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 the data controller is VONO MIMARLIK TASARIM INSAAT. The name, e-mail, phone number and message you send through this form are processed solely to assess and answer your enquiry and, where relevant, to prepare a proposal. They are not used for any other purpose, not shared with third parties and not transferred abroad; they are kept on our own server and deleted within a reasonable time after your enquiry is closed. This consent covers our reply only; separate permission is asked before we send any promotional message. You may exercise your rights under article 11 of the law - information, correction, deletion and objection - by writing to the e-mail address above.
